hook: Your boat ride in Assam lands on the world's largest river island.
title: This Indian Island Sits Inside a River
description:
Majuli in Assam sits in the Brahmaputra and is recognised as the world's largest river island. You reach it by boat, and people live, farm and study there. Part of the Places That Shouldn't Exist series.

#Shorts #Majuli #IndiaFacts
comment_prompt: Would you visit? Yes or no
